classification_policy.specific_notice_precedence: The unmodified krita/data/README applies CC-BY-3.0 to every GBR and GIH brush and takes precedence over the bundle-wide declaration.
classification_policy.bundle_default: All remaining original entries inherit the explicit CC-0 declaration in meta.xml. The Krita bundle editor reads and writes this field as the license of the resource bundle.
classification_policy.replacement_preview: The root preview.png is same-size opaque-white replacement content dedicated under CC0-1.0; its bytes are validated by white-brand-assets.json.
classification_policy.individual_override_audit: All 117 KPP preset XML records and all three SVG brush tips contain no individual legal override. Embedded PNG author fields are recorded below and remain applicable.
classification_policy.attribution: Each sealed inventory record points to the unmodified README and meta.xml creator fields that apply, plus any more-specific embedded PNG Author value.
